description: Create a tracked link by uploading a PDF to your EveryPage account (from a local path, or by fetching any user-supplied https URL) and get the tracked link, embed code and QR URL — applying share settings to the new file in the same call

settings.description: FileSettings fields to apply in the same call: viewerMode (standard|scroll|flipbook|swipe|magazine), password (empty string clears), allowDownload, requireEmail, notifyOnView, deleteAt (date-time), neverExpire, viewLimit (0 clears), gateDomains, gateFields, gateHeading, slug, watermark, pageRange.

source.description: A local file path, or any https URL: for a URL, the server fetches the user-supplied address itself (without sending your EveryPage key) and uploads the bytes it returns. The bytes must start with the PDF magic %PDF-.

name: everypage_share_pdf
